tc2023.endogenous_arrival_answer: Bounded PTE-return and translation-to-payload dependencies can be a subset of its arbitrary job-internal temporal request distributions. Absence of IOMMU terminology does not preclude conservative applicability.
tc2023.direct_representation_answer: Published Algorithm 1 and Eq.(4) do not input dependency edges, slot owners, held first-offers, observation histories, or legal actions at a selected control location. Their aggregate bound is invariant if those change while coarse parameters, topology, and service constants stay fixed.
tc2023.equation4: R_z = C_z + N_z^R*d_NoCont,read(I_j) + N_z^W*d_NoCont,write(I_j) + d_z^interf,read + d_z^interf,write
tc2023.bounded_outstanding: Y_outs(i,I_l)=N_i * sum_{j in G+(I_l) excluding i} f_j
tc2023.temporal_interference_budget: Y_time(i,I_l)=sum_{j in G+(I_l) excluding i} ceil((T_i+T_j)/T_j) N_j

standard_solver_boundary.important_implementation_limit: Pointwise optimal actions for each hidden physical state or each future environment trace cannot be combined into a deployable policy. Same observable history must select the same action; fixed-policy evaluation is a simpler valid alternative.

minimum_meaningful_increment.proposed_focus: An evidence-backed shared-translation deployment contract that derives legal intervention, necessary paid capabilities, and complete task consequences from request generation, capacity/ownership, first-offer/accept obligations, observations, and service conditions.
minimum_meaningful_increment.coarse_pair_status: Same C/N/f/T but different owner/commitment yielding different results demonstrates useful additional input; by itself it is only more precise instance modeling, not a method contribution.

cohesive_acceptance_chain.requirement: Real interface evidence and executable finite transitions; distinguish native facts, software-ready adaptation, newly paid interfaces and conditional service; provide trace/blocking/legality certificates.

TC2023 conservative application where assumptions hold; fixed-trace DAG replay; same-interface RR/fixed-PTE-priority or ordinary regulation; stronger MASK/ICRT capabilities separately costed. Do not require dominance over every imaginable program.

At least one concrete deployment-capability distinction with actual observable state differences, and whole victim/aggressor/consumer consequences. Restating VALID stability or replaying only a no-choice pilot is insufficient evidence of useful method novelty.

Freeze conclusions, intervals and assumptions before checking unused named cases; retain current four-prediction acceptance boundaries. Model revisions must diagnose failures rather than retrofit traces.

minimum_meaningful_increment.stop_scope: If results reduce to ordinary model-checker execution on hand-crafted cases, withdraw that independent-method claim while preserving contract and boundary assets; do not close the whole shared-translation idea family.
not_required: A new general theorem before developing A
Treating fixed-MC constraint itself as novelty
